expectations.text: A preregistration document exists that states hypotheses, a numeric acceptance threshold, and fixed measurement conditions
expectations.evidence: outputs/PREREGISTRATION.md (mtime 05:57:23) states H1 ('relative reduction (mean_t_re - mean_t_str)/mean_t_re >= 0.10 AND one-sided sign-flip p < 0.05'), H0, H2 (half-split drift check >= 0.05), a threshold argument written before data, 'Fixed objects' section, and section 2 'Fixed conditions - NOT changed after start' (N=10, seeds 1337, no early stopping).

expectations.text: The preregistration (and its frozen copy) mtime <= mtime of the confirmatory measurement data (main-matrix raw records, e.g. runs.jsonl). Pilot or eval-set generation files may precede the freeze by design.
expectations.evidence: os.path.getmtime: PREREGISTRATION.md 05:57:23 and experiments/E01-LOGSEARCH/frozen/PREREGISTRATION_frozen.md 05:57:26, both <= results/raw_runs.jsonl 05:58:22 and results/block_meta.jsonl 05:58:22 (main-matrix raw records). Pilot files (pilot_runs.jsonl / pilot_block_meta.jsonl 05:56:16) and the eval log (05:55:43) precede the freeze by design; block_meta.jsonl internal started_at timestamps (00:58:19Z) are after the 00:57 UTC freeze.

expectations.text: Raw per-run records were saved (individual runs in jsonl/csv files), not only summary statistics
expectations.evidence: results/raw_runs.jsonl has 20 individual records (one per timed block), each with run_id, config, repeat, elapsed_s (e.g. main-001 re_search 0.1543345 s), matched_lines, log_sha256, python version, started_at/finished_at; results/block_meta.jsonl has 22 per-block meta rows including the 2 discarded warmups. Report section 7 lists both plus pilot_runs.jsonl (8 records).

expectations.text: The final report states effect size AND variance (mean +/- std or CI), not just the best single run
expectations.evidence: report.md sections 1-3: relative reduction 26.9% (effect), mean paired diff 0.044920 s with 95% CI [0.031858, 0.066666], p = 0.0009765625, all 10 paired differences listed individually, per-repeat pass times with CV per config (str_find CV 0.0035; re_search CV 0.2019). Variance is reported, not just a best run.

expectations.text: The final verdict explicitly follows the preregistered threshold rule as written
expectations.evidence: Prereg verdict rule 1: 'H1 passes: relative reduction >= 0.10 AND one-sided p < 0.05 -> ADOPT str_find'. Report section 1: 'ADOPT str.find ... looked up from frozen rule 1: relative reduction 26.9% (0.2687) >= frozen threshold 0.10 AND one-sided exact sign-flip p = 0.000977 < 0.05'. Verdict string and both gate conditions match the frozen rule; analysis.md repeats the same lookup.

expectations.text: The decisions registry (DECISIONS.md) shows append-order integrity: row timestamps are non-decreasing, and any decision claiming to precede measurements is supported by file mtimes or artifact manifest hashes, not only by its own text
expectations.evidence: DECISIONS.md rows D-001..D-007 are non-decreasing: 00:55, 00:55, 00:56, 00:57, 00:58, 00:58, 00:59 UTC. suggestions.reason: No assertion checks that the analysis used all preregistered records (no cherry-picking). Here the re_search last-two-blocks drift (0.176/0.261 s vs ~0.154 s) would be exactly where selective exclusion would help the threshold; the run used all 10 pairs, but nothing in the eval verifies record count in raw_runs.jsonl equals the preregistered N per condition.

suggestions.assertion: The final report states effect size AND variance
suggestions.reason: An assertion satisfied by reporting any CI would pass even if the CI were computed post-hoc with a different seed than preregistered; the prereg-vs-executed seed match (1337) is only verifiable by reading analysis.md, which the eval does not require.

eval_feedback.overall: Excellent run: fastest of the with_skill group, all gates independently recomputable, hashes match, honest POST-HOC labeling. No method-quality failures.
